notes: Posted starting cards: the Objective (under 'Objective') and one Visage Of The Emperor ('x3(one you start)'); Prepared Defenses is listed under Interrupts and the strategy says the three effects it fetches vary by matchup. All count toward the 60.

Come Here You Big Coward, Secret Plans, No Escape and Allegations Of Corruption are posted under Effects(15) in a deck built with no Reflections III; dested as the Effects, not the Reflections III Defensive Shields of the same names.

Posted 'Zuchuss In Ship' (under Ships) dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Maul's Ship' dested Maul's Sith Infiltrator; 'Maul's Saber' / 'Vader's Saber' dested Maul's Lightsaber / Vader's Lightsaber; 'Executor Med Chamber' dested Executor: Meditation Chamber; 'Twilek Advisor' dested Twi'lek Advisor.

Run-together location names ('Blockade FlagshipBridge', 'HothDefensive Perimeter', 'EndorForest Clearing', 'NabooTheed Palace Throne Room') dested the Dark sites; the Throne Room is the Dark Coruscant-set site (strategy: tech vs the new Reflections III Light objective).
The strategy lists 'Cards I would like' (Wipe Them Out, All Of Them; Elis Helrot; Prince Xizor; Cloud City: Lower Passage; 4-LOM) as cards 61–65; they are not in the 60 and are not listed.
The strategy invites readers to FreedomCon; the list itself is not stated to have been played there.
